# Workspace Booking Procedure

This procedure explains how staff reserve shared desks in the fictional Riverside office.

## 1. Purpose

Shared desks are limited. Booking ahead keeps seating fair and lets the facilities team plan cleaning.

## 2. Scope

This applies to every hot desk on floors two and three. Meeting rooms use a separate procedure.

## 3. Booking a Desk

### 3.1 Before You Book

Check the floor plan for quiet zones. Desks near the windows fill up first on Mondays.

### 3.2 Making a Booking

Use the booking portal and follow these steps.

- Choose the date and floor.
- Pick a free desk on the map.
- Confirm and keep the booking reference.

## 4. Cancellations

Cancel at least two hours before the booking starts so the desk returns to the pool. Three missed bookings in a month pause booking rights for one week.

## 5. Escalation

If the portal is down, contact the facilities desk.

| Issue | Contact |
| --- | --- |
| Portal outage | Facilities desk |
| Broken equipment | Service desk |
